keys.description: Allow scrolling past the last line in the editor / file pane so it can sit at the top of the viewport. Terminal scroll-past-end is configured separately under Controls.
keys.label: Scroll Past Last Line (Editor)

keys.description: Modal editing in file / editor panes: open in Normal mode (h j k l to move, i / a to insert, v for Visual, d / c / y operators). Esc returns to Normal.
keys.label: Vim Keys (Editor)

keys.description: Keep web-pane cookies on disk so a sign-in survives close and restart.
keys.label: Stay Signed In (Web Pane)

keys.description: Anchor the last row at the top or middle when scrolling past the bottom.
keys.label: Scroll Past Last Line (Terminal)

keys.description: Anchor the first row at the bottom or middle when scrolling above the top.
keys.label: Scroll Past First Line (Terminal)

keys.description: Keep the past-end offset as new output arrives, instead of draining back to the bottom.
keys.label: Scroll Past Last Line — Sticky

keys.description: Scroll at pixel granularity instead of snapping row by row.
keys.label: Smooth Scroll (Terminal)

keys.description: How the view follows the scroll the terminal does to itself when a program prints past the last row. 'auto' follows Smooth Scroll (Terminal).
keys.label: Output Scroll Animation

keys.description: Hide the scrollbar while output is streaming; it comes back when you scroll up.
keys.label: Hide Scrollbar While Following Output

keys.description: Bind a key chord to an action. Repeatable. See the [Keybindings Reference](/reference/keybindings) for triggers and action names.
